mask_note: All inter-model agreement uses the existing pipeline masks, nearest-resized; earlier comparison records used a source-threshold fill-hole mask. Earlier DA3 geometry diagnostics are retained with their original masks and are not a controlled mask-matched comparison.
caveat: Model agreement is not ground-truth accuracy or cross-view consistency. ZipDepth is distilled from DA2 Large. The atlases differ in shape, pose, framing, material, color and line pattern; this is not a pixel-only ablation.

notes: Depth is relative, not meters.
No hand modeling or known-camera constraint supplied.
The generated views were requested as 22.5-degree steps, but are not calibrated.
Raw network forward and official InputProcessor used, without high-level export or autocast.
Six auxiliary-ray LayerNorm affine tensors absent from the official checkpoint retain identity defaults; depth and camera decoder are fully loaded; ray pose is not used.

V2.output_convention: Inverse relative depth; larger means nearer. Not meters, not calibrated across views.
V2.image_mapping: Entire 312x312 crop is resized to the network square, then bilinearly returned to 312x312; no crop or recentering.
notes: All 16 existing original-sheet crops, no new image generation or hand modeling.
Official unchanged source and tensor-only checkpoint loading.
Depth contact visualization is independently normalized per view and cannot show absolute cross-view scale consistency.
No camera pose or confidence prediction; do not substitute these maps directly into metric fusion.
No paid inference API; download, setup, and load excluded from inference runtime.
